item.title: Mark Ciocca: Art as regional pride
item.description: For Scranton-area artist Mark Ciocca, art and teaching go together. Since childhood he has loved drawing and when he was young, began filling notebooks with black lines. He has spent his adult life teaching art and creating it, an impressive body of work that tells the story of the people of Northeastern Pennsylvania. item.title: Hazleton Area High School students participate in band celebration
item.description: Four Hazleton Area High School students participated in the Marywood University Junior Wind Band Celebration on December 5 and 6, 2025. The band members were accepted based on a recommendation of their abilities in the Hazleton Area High School band and auditioned along with students from several area schools. The students rehearsed for two days with notable guest conductors from around the United States and performed at a concert.

item.title: Hazleton Elks Lodge donates to Ferrwood Music Camp
item.description: Hazleton Elks Lodge recently donated $500 to Ferrwood Music Camp in Drums. The summer music program and camp facility is administered by CAN DO Community Foundation volunteers. For information, visit www.ferrwood.org.

item.title: DISTRICT 2 DIVING: White sets record, takes home diving gold; Kuzma, Roosa, O’Hearn also crowned champs
item.description: WILKES-BARRE — Abington Heights’ Micah White has already put up a decorated diving career, and Saturday that career became even better as he etched his name into the record books. The junior broke the District 2 record with an 11-dive score of 543.15 to capture his second straight Class 3A boys gold medal at the District 2 Diving Championships at the Wyoming Valley Catholic Youth Center. item.title: Parmy Olson: The AI panic ignores something important — the evidence
item.description: Last week, a post written by tech entrepreneur and investor Matt Shumer went viral on social media. Titled “Something Big Is Happening,” it was a rundown of all the ways artificial intelligence would, in short order, decimate professional jobs.

item.title: COMMUNITY DIGEST: Feb. 22, 2026
item.description: Greater Hazleton Area and beyond Hazleton Art League’s Annual Member Show: Through Feb. 22. Hayden Family Center for the Arts, 31 W. Broad St., Hazleton.
